risks: Restating existing consent, cancellation and retention contracts creates a minor maintenance risk if those sections later change independently.
scores.rationale: Mechanical validation passes, and repository review confirms consistency with the existing contracts. The patch answers all five subquestions with bounded consent, opt-in interruption rules, mandatory service stops, durable suppression, minimized override records, explicit calibration acceptance and visible status. It changes only the three allowed files, uses Status: Solved, preserves question metadata and retains human review. Numerical qualification and implementation gates remain explicitly separate.
